_meta.status: DRAFT -- plan.md names four interlocks by label only; these are the first written rules and need M4's review
_meta.family: F5 -- forbidden pattern over step sequence. Each rule is: TRIGGER must not occur unless REQUIRES_BEFORE occurred earlier in the same scope.
_meta.split: V4a = the two interlocks STATED in the assertion block (tests whether the model applies a given fact). V4b = the two WITHHELD (tests latent knowledge). plan.md 13 Q6c: averaging them is uninterpretable, and V4b denominators must be reported.

interlocks.name: hot work requires gas-free certification
interlocks.rule: No cutting, welding, burning or grinding in or adjacent to a tank or enclosed space until that space has been gas-freed and certified safe for hot work.
interlocks.reachable_note: cutting is a salvage step in these three; in on_fire it is implausible during the fire and so not scored

interlocks.name: no entry after fixed-gas release until ventilated and tested
interlocks.rule: After release of a fixed gas extinguishing system (CO2, inert gas) into a space, no person may enter that space until it has been thoroughly ventilated and its atmosphere tested.
interlocks.reachable_note: n = 16 and only where the plan releases fixed gas at all -- plan.md 13 Q6c's small-denominator case. Report descriptively, never inferentially.

interlocks.name: enclosed space entry requires atmosphere test and standby
interlocks.rule: No person may enter an enclosed, flooded or previously sealed space without a prior atmosphere test and an attendant standing by at the entrance.
interlocks.reachable_note: the widest of the four -- any inspection or dewatering step can reach it

interlocks.name: equalise pressure before breaking a boundary
interlocks.rule: No hatch, manhole, valve or shell boundary may be opened on a space holding a head of water or a pressure differential until the pressure has been equalised or the space vented.
interlocks.scope: same space, where space is flooded
interlocks.reachable_note: requires a flooded compartment, so not reachable in a dry on_fire casualty
